title: Gold slips toward $4,150 as yields and the dollar climb
summary: Gold traded around $4,150–4,170 in early October, below the January record near $5,500–5,600 and above the late-June low near $3,955–3,995.
ict: A bullish Dollar Index means bearish gold. On the June-low to January-high range, equilibrium is near $4,750, so gold trades in discount. ICT would want AUD and NZD to confirm, and a quarterly shift in structure, before considering longs.
